summary: Counts threshold crossing events in CHOP channels, with trigger/release thresholds, reset behavior, limit modes, and optional increment-value input.
key_concepts: Counts how many times a channel crosses trigger or release thresholds in either static or Cook to Current Frame mode.
The default trigger is an upward crossing from less-than-or-equal-to zero to greater than zero.
Separate trigger and release thresholds allow hysteresis, while Trigger On chooses increasing or decreasing crossings.
Off to On, While On, On to Off, and While Off menus choose whether events increment, decrement, count by time, or reset.
The optional second input is reset pulses, and the third input supplies custom increment values instead of the default plus or minus one.
Limit modes can leave counts unlimited, loop, clamp, mixed loop/clamp, or zigzag between minimum and maximum values.

key_params.name: threshold
key_params.note: Use trigger threshold as release threshold

key_params.name: retrigger
key_params.note: Delay before another trigger can occur

key_params.name: triggeron
key_params.note: Trigger on increasing or decreasing values

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: Limit behavior: off, loop, clamp, mixed, or zigzag

key_params.name: offtoon
key_params.note: Operation when trigger goes off to on

key_params.name: ontooff
key_params.note: Operation when trigger goes on to off

key_params.name: resetcondition
key_params.note: How the reset input resets counts

common_gotchas: Default triggering is an upward crossing past 0, but trigger and release thresholds can be separated for hysteresis.
The second input is interpreted as reset pulses and resets all channels when nonzero.
The third input supplies custom increment values; without it, Count uses plus or minus one or time-based increments.
Time-based counts depend on CHOP sample rate, not only timeline frame rate.
Reset While On holds channels at the reset value until the reset input turns off.
